privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: By visiting the website rubengroup.am (hereinafter referred to as the “Website”) and making purchases, you automatically consent to the collection, processing, and use of your personal data.

By "Personal Data," we mean any information that allows or may allow us to directly or indirectly identify your identity, such as your name, surname, address, email, phone number, and other data (hereinafter referred to as "Data").

In this Privacy Policy, "we," "us," and "our" refer to Website (for more information, please visit the "About Us" section), while "you," "your," and "yours" refer to any individual who visits the Website or uses our services.

sections.heading: 1. Collected Data
paragraphs: We may collect the following types of information:
bullets: Contact information – name, surname, address, phone number, email address
Purchase information – products purchased, payment methods
Technical information – device type, browser, operating system
Cookies and tracking technologies – for website usage analysis

sections.heading: 2. Use of Data
paragraphs: Collected data is never sold or provided to third parties for marketing purposes. It is used only for the following purposes:
bullets: Processing and shipping orders
Providing user support
Improving website functionality
Complying with legal requirements

sections.heading: 3. Data Retention Periods
paragraphs: Your personal data is stored as follows:
bullets: User account data – as long as the account is active
Purchase history – 5 years (to comply with tax and accounting regulations)
Marketing data – 2 years or until the user opts out

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the protection of your data, including:
bullets: SSL encryption – to secure payment and personal data transmission
Access control – limited access to personal data
Regular audits – to detect potential security vulnerabilities

sections.heading: 5. Sharing Data with Third Parties
paragraphs: We do not sell or provide your data to third parties, except for:
bullets: Shipping services – to ensure order delivery
Payment systems – for secure payment processing
Law enforcement authorities – in cases required by law

paragraphs: All third parties are obligated to protect your data and cannot use it for other purposes.

sections.heading: 6. User Rights
paragraphs: You have the right to:
bullets: Receive a copy of your personal data
Edit or delete your data (through our website settings or customer support)
Opt-out of marketing emails (via the "unsubscribe" link in each email)
Request that your data is not processed for specific purposes, except in cases required by law

sections.heading: 7. Cookies Usage
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies to optimize user experience. We use:
bullets: Functional cookies – to ensure proper website operation
Analytical cookies – to understand user behavior and improve the website
Marketing cookies (only with your consent) – to provide more relevant advertisements

sections.heading: 8. Policy Changes
paragraphs: We reserve the right to make legally permitted changes to this page and the above sections. Updates will be posted on the Website.

sections.heading: 1. General Provisions
paragraphs: 1.1. These Terms and Conditions govern the use of rubengroup.am website (hereinafter referred to as the "Website").
1.2. By accessing or using the Website, you agree to these Terms.
1.3. If you do not agree to any part of these Terms, please do not use the Website.
1.4. The Website reserves the right to modify these Terms without prior notice. Changes become effective upon their publication on the Website.
1.5. Continued use of the Website implies acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.heading: 2. Key Definitions
paragraphs: The following definitions apply in these Terms:
bullets: Website – The online platform rubengroup.am offering services, content, and various functionalities.
User – Any individual or legal entity accessing or using the Website.
Services – All products, services, content, and tools available via the Website.
Content – Any text, images, videos, audio, or other materials available on the Website.
Intellectual Property – Website name, logo, texts, software, and other elements protected by copyright or trademark law.
Transaction – Any purchase, service registration, or other contractual agreement on the Website.

sections.heading: 3. User Obligations
paragraphs: 3.1. The User agrees to:
bullets: Use the Website only for lawful purposes.
Not interfere with the Website’s technical operation.
Not distribute viruses, malware, or any harmful code.
Not attempt to illegally access Website servers or data.
Not publish or distribute illegal, offensive, defamatory, or hate-inducing content.

paragraphs: 3.2. The Website reserves the right to block any User who violates these Terms.

sections.heading: 4. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: 4.1. The Website is provided "as is" without any warranties.
4.2. The Website is not responsible for:
bullets: Any errors or technical malfunctions.
Incorrect or false information entered by Users.
Damages resulting from third-party interactions with the Website.
The accuracy, reliability, or timeliness of the content provided.

paragraphs: 4.3. The Website is not liable for indirect damages, including lost revenue or data loss.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: 5.1. All materials on the Website, including texts, images, logos, and software, belong to the Website or its rightful owners.
5.2. Copying, distributing, selling, or using any content without prior written permission is strictly prohibited.
5.3. The User has no right to use the Website’s trademark or domain name without written permission.

sections.heading: 6. Payments and Refunds
paragraphs: 6.1. If the Website offers paid services, payments must be made under the specified conditions.
6.2. The Website may change prices or payment terms without prior notice.
6.3. If applicable, refund policies will be outlined separately on the Website.

sections.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: 7.1. These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Armenia.
7.2. All disputes should first be resolved through negotiations.
7.3. If negotiations fail, disputes will be handled in the competent courts of Armenia.

sections.heading: 8. Force Majeure
paragraphs: 8.1. The Website is not responsible for failure or delay in fulfilling obligations due to force majeure circumstances, including:
bullets: Natural disasters (earthquakes, floods, fires, etc.).
Governmental restrictions or prohibitions.
Military conflicts, terrorism, or civil unrest.

sections.heading: 9. Privacy and Data Protection
paragraphs: 9.1. The Website commits to protecting user data in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
9.2. The Website may collect and process user data for legal purposes.
9.3. The Website reserves the right to disclose user data to authorities as required by law.

refund.title: Return and Exchange Policy
refund.intro: At RUBEN GROUP, we want your purchase from rubengroup.am to fully meet your expectations. If you need to return or exchange a product, the main conditions are outlined below.

sections.heading: 1. Exchange
bullets: Purchased items, except for special-order, custom-sized, or customer-modified products, are eligible for exchange within 14 days.
An exchange is possible only if the product has not been used, installed, or assembled and retains its resalable condition, complete set, and original factory packaging.
An official receipt or electronic proof of purchase is required for exchanges.

sections.heading: 2. Returns
bullets: Purchased items, except for special-order, custom-sized, or customer-modified products, can be returned within 14 days.
The product must be unused, uninstalled, unassembled, undamaged, complete, and in its original factory packaging.
An official receipt or electronic proof of purchase is required for returns.
If we mistakenly deliver the wrong product, the customer may return it or exchange it for the correct product at no additional charge.
A product submitted for return or exchange must not show signs of use, installation, assembly, cutting, drilling, or any other modification.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds
bullets: If the returned product meets the conditions above, the refund will be issued using the same payment method used for the original purchase.
Refunds for card payments will be processed within up to 7 business days, depending on the bank’s processing procedures.
Delivery fees are non-refundable, except where an incorrect or damaged product was delivered.

sections.heading: 4. Order Cancellation
bullets: An order may be canceled before the delivery process begins.
If the order has already been handed over for delivery, it cannot be canceled; where applicable, the return conditions will apply.

sections.heading: 5. Special and Custom Orders
paragraphs: Special-order products, items made in custom sizes, colors, or configurations, as well as products cut or otherwise modified at the customer’s request, cannot be returned or exchanged, except in cases of a manufacturing defect or incorrect delivery.

sections.heading: 6. Non-Returnable Items
bullets: Used, installed, or assembled products
Products cut, modified, or made to custom dimensions at the customer’s request
Special-order products or items manufactured in a custom configuration
Products damaged by the customer or returned with incomplete components or packaging

paragraphs: Special Note: If a product is damaged, visibly defective, or does not match the order, please contact us before installation or assembly.

delivery.title: Delivery and Shipping Terms
delivery.intro: At RUBEN GROUP, we aim to deliver renovation products—including tiles, sanitary ware, bathroom and bedroom furniture, and other goods—quickly, safely, and conveniently. Below are the main delivery terms for orders placed through rubengroup.am.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery Timeframes
bullets: Delivery time depends on the product type, availability, order volume, delivery address, as well as the product dimensions and weight.
The estimated delivery timeframe is agreed and confirmed during order processing.
If there are any changes or potential delays, our team will contact you in advance.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery Options
paragraphs: We offer the following delivery options:
bullets: Standard delivery – carried out to the address and within the timeframe agreed in advance.
Delivery terms for bulky or heavy products are agreed separately, taking the product dimensions and weight into account.

sections.heading: 3. Delivery Fees
bullets: Delivery fees are calculated based on the delivery address, order volume, product dimensions, and weight.
The final delivery fee is communicated and agreed before the order is confirmed.

sections.heading: 4. Possible Delays
paragraphs: Despite our efforts, in some cases delivery may be delayed due to:
bullets: Adverse weather conditions
Transportation or logistics issues
Product availability, order preparation, or peak workload

paragraphs: If a delay occurs, we will notify you in advance and provide an updated delivery timeframe.
